system:
You map concepts from prior manuscripts onto variables documented in specific data sources.
Rules:
- For every concept, produce one mapping per data source listed.
- `concept` must be copied exactly as given in the list (the text inside the quotes). Do not append the role or reword it.
- `variable` must be a name from that source's variable list below, exactly as printed, or null when no equivalent exists.
- `compatibility`: "direct" (same construct, same measurement), "proxy" (related construct), "derived" (computable from one or more listed variables; name the primary one and explain in rationale), or "none" (variable null).
- Prefer null over a stretch. A wrong mapping is worse than a missing one.
- `source_summaries`: one paragraph per source on what it can and cannot support for these concepts.

transcript.user:
Concepts to map (from the manuscripts), each with its role and how it was operationalized:
- "Sudden unexpected infant death (SUID)" (role: outcome) — ICD-10 codes R95, R99, and W75, excluding deaths in the first postnatal week
- "Infant sex" (role: exposure) — Primary exposure of interest, used to estimate sex-specific SUID incidence trajectories across early infancy
- "Postconceptional age (PCA)" (role: covariate) — Defined as gestational age at birth plus postnatal age and served as the primary developmental time scale
- "Maternal smoking during pregnancy" (role: covariate) — Any reported smoking was included as a covariate because it is an established risk factor for SUID and shifts the postnatal age at death
- "Preterm birth" (role: covariate) — Defined as a binary variable (<37 versus ≥37 completed gestational weeks)
- "Breastfeeding status at discharge" (role: covariate) — Included in sensitivity analysis to assess whether breastfeeding modified sex-specific trajectories
- "postconceptional age" (role: exposure) — Postconceptional age window (36-42 weeks, early rising window; 43-46 weeks, peak/transition interval; >=47 weeks, late declining window)
- "sex" (role: stratifier) — Sex of the infant (Female; Male)
- "year of birth or death" (role: stratifier) — Year of birth or death (2014-2015; 2016-2017; 2018-2019; 2020-2021)
- "SUID" (role: outcome) — Cause of death categorized as Sudden infant death syndrome (R95), Accidental suffocation and strangulation in bed (W75), or Other ill-defined and unspecified causes of mortality (R99)
- "bed sharing" (role: exposure) — Case-level bed sharing was classified from NCFRP death-scene sleep-environment variables rather than from PRAMS. Direct evidence of same-surface sharing was retained as bed sharing.
- "birthweight" (role: stratifier) — Models were stratified by low birthweight (<2,500 g).
- "PCA (postconceptional age)" (role: outcome) — Postconceptional age is the time elapsed since conception, measured in weeks.
- "chronological age" (role: offset) — Chronological age is the time elapsed since birth, measured in weeks.
- "sex (male, female)" (role: stratifier) — Sex is recorded as male or female.
- "birthweight (low, non-low)" (role: stratifier) — Birthweight is categorized as low or non-low.
- "maternal smoking status (smoking, non-smoking)" (role: stratifier) — Maternal smoking is categorized as smoking or non-smoking.
- "Maternal prepregnancy body mass index (BMI)" (role: exposure) — calculated as weight in kilograms divided by height in meters squared.
- "Gestational age at birth" (role: covariate) — measured in weeks.
- "Maternal infections in pregnancy" (role: exposure) — chlamydia, gonorrhea and hepatitis C.
- "Age of death in SUID cases" (role: outcome) — measured as days since birth.
- "Geographic location" (role: stratifier) — state, latitude, and longitude.
- "inner ear dysfunction" (role: exposure) — induced by intra-tympanic gentamicin (IT-Gent) injections bilaterally or unilaterally to precipitate inner ear hair cell dysfunction.
- "control condition" (role: exposure) — received intra-tympanic saline (IT-Saline) bilaterally or unilaterally, or intra-peritoneal gentamicin (IP-Gent).
- "body movement arousal response to severe hypoxia-hypercarbia" (role: outcome) — measured under light anesthesia 8 days following the administration of gentamicin or saline.
- "hypercapnic ventilatory response" (role: outcome) — measured as part of assessing arousal responses to severe hypoxia-hypercarbia.
- "age of mice" (role: covariate) — not explicitly stated, but implied to be within a timeframe suitable for the experiment.
- "baseline cSN activity" (role: outcome) — measured as increased baseline sympathetic nerve activity following CIH exposure.
- "breathing frequency" (role: outcome) — measured as an increase in breathing rate after chronic intermittent hypoxia.
- "expiratory time" (role: outcome) — measured as a decrease in the duration of expiration following CIH exposure.
- "PiCo specific cholinergic-glutamatergic neurons" (role: exposure) — optogenetically stimulated to assess changes in respiratory-sympathetic coupling.
- "glutamatergic PiCo neurons" (role: exposure) — optogenetically stimulated to assess changes in respiratory-sympathetic coupling.
- "ChAT containing neurons" (role: exposure) — optogenetically stimulated to assess changes in respiratory-sympathetic coupling.
- "Dbx1 and Vglut2 neurons" (role: exposure) — optogenetically stimulated to assess changes in respiratory-sympathetic coupling.
- "preBötzinger complex (preBötC)" (role: exposure) — optogenetically stimulated to assess changes in respiratory-sympathetic coupling.
- "chronic intermittent hypoxia (CIH)" (role: exposure) — mice exposed to chronic intermittent hypoxia for 21 days.
- "diaphragm activity" (role: outcome) — measured as changes in diaphragm muscle activity.
- "vagus nerve activity" (role: outcome) — measured as changes in vagal nerve activity.
- "cervical sympathetic nerve activity" (role: outcome) — measured as changes in cervical sympathetic nerve activity.
- "chronic intermittent hypoxia (IH)" (role: exposure) — 30 days of IH exposure (IH30) in a murine model.
- "adult neurogenesis" (role: outcome) — Measured by immunohistochemical experiments assessing Sox2+ neural progenitor cells, doublecortin-positive neurons, and radial glial cells in the subgranular zone.
- "synaptic plasticity" (role: outcome) — Assessed by paired-pulse facilitation and long-term potentiation (LTP).
- "reactive oxygen species (ROS)" (role: effect_modifier) — Measured by lipid peroxidation and mitigated with antioxidant treatment.
- "breathing patterns" (role: exposure) — Measured using plethysmography during the first hour after birth in mice born at term, delivered prematurely with LPS, or via C-section.
- "survival" (role: outcome) — Measured as mortality rates in mice born prematurely or at term.
- "inhibition" (role: exposure) — Investigated using a biophysical model and in vitro recordings from mouse pre-Bötzinger complex.
- "excitation" (role: exposure) — Investigated using partial excitation block and in vitro recordings from mouse pre-Bötzinger complex.
- "lipopolysaccharide (LPS)" (role: exposure) — Administered intraperitoneally at 0.14 mg/kg to pregnant dams on gestational day 18.5.
- "progesterone" (role: exposure) — Administered intraperitoneally at 42 mg/kg to pregnant dams on embryonic day 17.5.
- "neurogenesis" (role: outcome) — Assessed by T-box transcription factor 2 (Tbr2) intermediate neural progenitor cell density and BrdU labeling.
